projects.title: Custom Stock Trend Predictor
projects.description: Designed a web-based tool using Flask for technical analysis of stocks, displaying future predicted curves and numerical stock data. Analyzed different models forecasting and predicting the most accurate future stock prices.

projects.title: Smart ATS Resume Tracker
projects.description: Developed a resume matching system integrating Google Gemini Pro Large Language Model (LLM) for concise analysis and percentage-based evaluation of candidate resumes against job descriptions, leading to a 50% improvement in candidate shortlisting.

projects.title: Quantum Perceptron for Pattern Classification
projects.description: Implemented an Artificial Neuron on IBM’s Qiskit quantum simulator exploring its functionality and capabilities. Trained a 4 qubit perceptron using checkboard patterns for different numbers, evaluated its performance with various weight-input pairs and understand its behavior compared to a classical deep learning system.

projects.title: Medical Chat Bot
projects.description: Developed a medical chatbot allowing users to input medical and health-related queries, which are processed to understand the context and retrieve relevant information from a large language model.

projects.title: HSN Code Classification System
projects.description: Developed an intelligent HSN (Harmonized System Nomenclature) Code Classification System using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Knowledge Graphs. The system will help businesses accurately identify correct 8-digit HSN codes for products, addressing the challenges of complex hierarchies, similar product descriptions, and lack of domain expertise.

projects.title: AI-Resume-Parser
projects.description: Production-ready resume parser extracting structured information from PDF, DOC, DOCX, and TXT files using state-of-the-art LLM providers and transformer models. Supports multiple file formats with Google Colab testing, structured JSON output, and multiple LLM providers including OpenRouter, Google Gemini, OpenAI GPT, and local transformers.

projects.title: Medical FAQ RAG Chatbot
projects.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) chatbot for medical FAQs providing accurate, context-aware answers to patient queries using a knowledge base of medical information. Built with FAISS vector database, OpenAI GPT-3.5-turbo, and Streamlit interface for easy deployment and interaction.

projects.title: NLP Pinecone Agent
projects.description: Intelligent agent that converts natural language queries into Pinecone-compatible JSON filters for vector database search. Features robust date query processing, multi-LLM fallback, and comprehensive operator support. Uses hybrid approach combining LLM processing with rule-based fallbacks for reliable query conversion.
